question.text: The polymer formed on heating Novolac with formaldehyde is:

solution.text: Novolac on heating with formaldehyde undergoes cross-linking to form an infusible solid mass called Bakelite. It is a thermosetting polymer that cannot be reused or remoulded.  Bakelite is used for making combs, phonograph records, electrical switches, and handles of various utensils
